title: Ownership Checks on Orders and Payments
summary: GET /orders/:id and GET /payments/:orderId return a record only to its owner; anyone else gets the same 404 as for a missing record. Closes baseline gaps G1 and G2 and Phase 0's security exit criterion.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Owner gets their order through the gateway: 200, same body as today.
Non-owner gets 404 identical to a non-existent order; nothing reveals the order exists.
Owner gets the payment for their order: 200, same body as today.
Non-owner gets 404 for the payment, identical to an order with no payment.
Missing x-user-id on GET /orders/:id, GET /orders or GET /payments/:orderId gives 401, no data.
A non-UUID ID gives 404, not 500, on both endpoints.
Order list, order creation, saga and the assistant's own-order answers are unchanged.
Ownership unit-tested both ways for both endpoints; each test seen failing with the check removed.
Changed services rebuilt and healthy; AC-1, AC-2, AC-4 re-run through the gateway with real tokens.
Baseline G1/G2 closed, learnings entry updated, service READMEs and architecture describe the rule.
